Budanov: "Deep strikes cannot win a war. Deep strikes are a form of support, a tool of leverage and coercion. But they only work in combination with other forms of conventional warfare."

In Zheleznogorsk, Russia, Ukrainian drones struck an apartment building three times. It is currently unknown whether Russian electronic warfare was responsible. Only two people were reported injured, while other residents were evacuated. https://t.co/ABekxfLX96
